_meta._note: Content data for the character-name screen (D-146): the random-name pool and the blocked-term list for the name filter. Numeric limits (min/max length in grapheme clusters, allowed character set, phone/email/URL patterns, max re-rolls before fallback) are NOT here: they live in config/balance/character.json (systems-designer, P2-F10-T04). Schema: packages/shared/schemas/config/ (tech-lead, P2-F10-T07). Every string here is a plain string, never a regex.

randomName._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70
randomName._note: name = heads[i] + tails[j], concatenated with no separator. 16 x 16 = 256 distinct names. Every head is 3-6 display cells and every tail is 4-6 cells, so every name is 7-12 cells (grapheme clusters <= cells for Thai). Thai characters only, no space, no digit, so every name passes the character-set and phone/email/URL rules of character.json. No head or tail is a Thai personal name or nickname on its own, and no combination matches a known person or brand. Required test (P2-F10-T12): all 256 combinations pass the blocked-term filter below.

fallback._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70
fallback._note: Returned when the generator hits character.json max re-rolls (for example if a future config shortens maxLength below 12). Each is 6-8 cells, Thai only, passes the filter.
names: คนเดินเท้า

blockedTerms._note: Name filter word list (D-146). Phase 2 names stay on the device and are never shown to others, so this is a first line only; Phase 3 re-checks on the server (NN-1, risk R-F10-1..3). Categories exist for human review only (telemetry carries only the reject-count bucket of P2-F10-T05, never a category or a word): the player sees one generic message (copy key from P2-F10-T11) and is never told which word matched, so the list is not taught. Terms are plain strings stored already in light-normalized form (step list below); the module must still run the same normalization on every term at load time so an editor typo cannot bypass it.

normalization._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70
normalization._note: Apply to BOTH the input and every term. Two passes. A name is rejected if any pass finds a match after allow-list removal.
light: see config/balance/character.json#banned.passes.light (authoritative steps since P2-H64; this file keeps word lists only)
heavy: see config/balance/character.json#banned.passes.heavy (authoritative steps since P2-H64; this file keeps word lists only)

matchModes._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70

allow._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70
allow._note: Everyday words that contain a blocked term. Remove every occurrence (longest first) before matching, each list only in its own pass. allow.light is never applied in the heavy pass, because the heavy form of some entries (กู้ -> กู) would erase a real hit.

substring._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70
royal: เฉลิมพระเกียรติ
worldRule1: ผู้ถูกเลือก
พลังที่หลับใหล
impersonation: หน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง

substringHeavy._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70
substringHeavy._note: Checked on the heavy form so tone swaps and stretched letters do not bypass (เหี๊ย, เหี่ยยย, ควายยย). Each entry here is also in substring. Words whose tone-stripped form collides with normal words are left out on purpose: แม่ง -> แมง (แมงมุม), เชี่ย -> เชีย (เชียร์), ห่า -> หา, กู -> กู้, ตุ๊ด -> ตุด, โง่ -> โง.

token._source: P2-F10-T03 (narrative-designer) · design/narrative/F10-story.md sections 6-7 · _source added by orchestrator P2-H70
token._note: Short words that live inside normal words (กาก in กากหมู/สีกากี, ass in class, rape in grape). Blocked only as the whole name or a whole space-separated word.

blockedTerms._coverageNote: Not listed on purpose: names of real people or politicians (a list of them would itself be a list of real names; the real-name warning copy of P2-F10-T11 and the Phase 3 server review cover this), brand names (random names are brand-free; typed brand names are low harm while names are private), and nationality words such as ลาว or แขก that are also neutral everyday words. Evasion by spelling changes beyond the two passes is expected (risk R-F10-3) and is a Phase 3 server job.
